description: Registry of all MCP tools provided by servers in this directory. This file is documentation only — VS Code loads servers from .vscode/mcp.json, not from here.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Write text content to a file at an absolute path, creating parent directories as needed. Use this instead of the built-in create_file tool, which reverses line order.

parameters.path: Absolute path of the file to write.
parameters.content: Full text content to write to the file.

tools.name: get_current_datetime
tools.description: Return the current wall-clock date and time in both UTC and local time. Use this whenever the real current date/time is needed rather than a training-data cutoff or context timestamp.
